messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No. Consider B_n(x) = x^n, defined on [0,1]. Pointwise limit: f(x) = 0, x ∈ [0,1); f(1) = 1. Discontinuous limit. Uniform limits of continuous functions remain continuous. No uniform convergence. This example demonstrates pointwise convergence failing to yield uniformity.
